kind: Civilian radar candidate selection before detector output

case.event_time_uncertainty: Contractor says around noon local; this approximate UTC reference annotates timing only and does not change production date filters.

references.supports: Operator lists dated July 2 intact/closed bridge, November 6 demolition and November 16 cleanup galleries in 2021; preparatory work began May 2017. Gallery images were not independently inspected.
Demolition contractor confirms both approximately 310 m bridge spans were demolished November 6, 2021 around noon local (approximately 11:00 UTC).
October 29, 2021 joint authority statement explicitly dates new construction-site photographs to October 27 and documents closures and the forthcoming November 6 demolition.

July 2022 environmental authority report, printed pages 8-10, documents protective works and before/after wastewater assets; asset persistence does not establish unchanged surfaces or whole-AOI quietness.
Modern rebuilt south bridge footprint version 19; locator only, not the surveyed 2021 demolition footprint.
Modern rebuilt north bridge footprint version 6; the union of these two footprints fixes the AOI center before detector output.

case.label: Documented civilian bridge demolition; change candidate requiring imagery review
case.selection_basis: 500 m square centered on the union-bound midpoint of OSM bridge footprints 499938151 v19 and 1229149143 v6 (modern geometry used only as locator). Target [2021-11-06, 2021-11-13) contains the independently documented November 6 demolition; baseline [2021-10-09, 2021-11-06) ends before the event day. Any event-day acquisition would need a timing annotation, not silent removal. Public metadata inventory finds no November 6 acquisitions. Preparatory works may affect the baseline; target includes staging/cleanup, not demolition alone. Frozen before detector output.

case.label: Same-AOI pre-demolition reference candidate; quiet ground truth unavailable
case.selection_basis: Same frozen 500 m square. Target [2021-10-23, 2021-10-30) contains the authority-dated October 27 photographs; baseline [2021-09-25, 2021-10-23). This independently dated anchor supports bridge presence, not whole-AOI stability. Documented preparatory earthworks and protective interventions prevent a quiet label. Independent acquisition-bracketing evidence covering the entire AOI remains missing. Do not score detector responses here as false positives.

availability.note: Public availability is independently checked. Actual EE source inventory, valid pixels and comparison execution remain unverified.

quiet_reference.rejected_nearby_control: Adjacent wastewater plant had documented protective works and operational interventions; asset survival is not unchanged surface truth.

additional_bounded_lead.name: DLR Sentinel-1 Kalibri calibration experiment
additional_bounded_lead.result: Not selected: point-target impulse-response stability and background removal do not establish an entire land AOI as quiet.

quiet_reference.missing_evidence: Independent dated imagery/property evidence bracketing reference acquisitions over the full AOI and showing no material surface works during both intervals, or applicable distributed-target stability evidence with explicit AOI and dates.

record_timing_context.source: Actual retained comparison acquisition_times; no date-only fallback
record_timing_context.scope: Relative to approximate event time using source start timestamps; complete exposure intervals unavailable.
